title: New Orleans Bourbon Street truck attack
description: On January 1, 2025, Shamsud-Din Jabbar drove a pickup truck into crowds celebrating New Year on Bourbon Street, then opened fire, killing 14 people and injuring dozens before being fatally shot by police. The FBI classified the attack as a terrorist act inspired by the Islamic State, to which Jabbar pledged allegiance in videos posted before the attack.

title: Los Angeles wildfires (Palisades and Eaton fires)
description: The Palisades and Eaton fires began in Los Angeles County on January 7, 2025 local time and were contained on January 31. CAL FIRE records 31 civilian deaths and 16,264 destroyed structures across the two fires.

title: Gul Plaza shopping mall fire
description: A fire broke out at the Gul Plaza shopping centre in Karachi on the night of 17 January 2026. Pakistan's National Disaster Management Authority subsequently reported at least 80 deaths and dozens of injuries; an earlier inquiry report counted 79 deaths. The fire spread through the multistorey commercial building.

title: Nigeria fuel tanker explosion in Suleja
description: A fuel tanker accident and explosion at Dikko junction in Niger State on January 18, 2025 killed people gathered around spilled fuel. NEMA reported 98 deaths and 69 injuries in its January 28 update.

title: Antioch High School shooting
description: On January 22, 2025, 17-year-old Solomon Henderson shot and killed one student and wounded another in the Antioch High School cafeteria in Nashville, then died by suicide. Police reported ten shots within 17 seconds.

title: West Bandung landslide
location: West Bandung Regency, West Java, Indonesia
description: Heavy rain triggered a landslide in Pasirlangu village, West Bandung Regency, at about 02:30 local time on 24 January 2026 (23 January UTC), burying homes. By 10 February, West Java police had identified 80 victims. Identification of additional remains was continuing.

title: Unity oilfield plane crash
description: On January 29, 2025, a Beechcraft 1900D operated by Eagle Air on behalf of Light Air Services crashed shortly after takeoff from the Unity oilfield airstrip in Unity State, South Sudan, while carrying oil workers to Juba; 20 of the 21 people on board were killed.

title: Potomac River mid-air collision (American Airlines Flight 5342)
description: At about 01:48 UTC on January 30, 2025 (the evening of January 29 locally), PSA Airlines Flight 5342 and a US Army UH-60L helicopter collided near Reagan Washington National Airport and fell into the Potomac River. All 64 people on the airliner and three helicopter crew members died.

title: Kwara State attacks
description: Armed extremists attacked Woro and Nuku in Kaiama, Kwara State, on the evening of 3 February 2026. Local officials and the Red Cross reported at least 162 deaths, while the state government initially gave a lower count. Homes were burned and residents abducted. Reports differed over the attackers' affiliation, and no group immediately claimed responsibility.

title: Islamabad mosque suicide bombing
description: An attacker opened fire at the gates of the Khadija Tul Kubra Shia mosque in Islamabad's Tarlai area during Friday prayers on 6 February 2026 before detonating explosives. The death toll subsequently rose to 36. More than 100 people were injured. Islamic State claimed responsibility.

title: Tumbler Ridge school shooting
description: An 18-year-old former student killed eight people in Tumbler Ridge on 10 February 2026: her mother and 11-year-old brother at a home, and five students and a teacher at the secondary school. The perpetrator also died by suicide, bringing the total dead to nine. Twenty-seven people were reported injured.

title: Abiemnom massacre
description: Armed attackers raided Abiemnom in South Sudan's Ruweng Administrative Area on 1 March 2026. Local authorities reported 169 deaths, including 90 civilians. The UN mission said about 1,000 people sought shelter at its base. Accounts differed over the attackers' affiliation and the number injured.
sources: Global Centre for the Responsibility to Protect

title: Bahia Blanca flash floods
description: Flash flooding struck Bahia Blanca and surrounding areas on March 7, 2025, after 290 mm of rain in 12 hours. The confirmed death toll reached 18 after identification of the last missing child in May.

title: Syrian coastal massacres of Alawites
description: A Reuters investigation documented 1,479 Alawites killed at 40 sites during the March 7-9, 2025 massacres in Syria's coastal region. Its reporting linked attackers through a chain of command to figures serving alongside the country's new leadership; the count does not include all deaths in the wider fighting.

title: Jaffar Express hijacking
description: Baloch Liberation Army militants hijacked the Jaffar Express in Balochistan on March 11, 2025. Pakistan's military reported 31 victims killed, 354 hostages rescued and 33 attackers killed when the operation ended the following day.

title: Kocani nightclub fire
description: A fire at the Pulse nightclub in Kocani on March 16, 2025 killed 63 people and injured more than 200, according to figures cited in court indictments. Investigators reported that pyrotechnics ignited flammable ceiling foam in a venue lacking adequate fire safety provisions.

title: South Korea wildfire outbreak
description: Wildfires began in southeastern South Korea on March 21, 2025 and spread across several areas, including Uiseong and Sancheong. World Weather Attribution's April 30 account reported 32 deaths in the March outbreak; Copernicus also reports 32 deaths and around 5,000 buildings destroyed.

title: Qinyuan coal mine explosion
description: On 22 May 2026, an explosion at the Liushenyu coal mine in Qinyuan County, Shanxi Province, China, killed at least 82 miners, the worst coal-mining blast in China in more than a decade. The blast in one of China's major coal-producing regions prompted a state investigation into safety practices.

title: Air India Flight 171 crash
description: Air India Flight 171, a Boeing 787-8 bound for London Gatwick, crashed shortly after takeoff from Ahmedabad at about 08:09 UTC on June 12, 2025, striking B. J. Medical College hostel buildings. The official preliminary report records 241 deaths among 242 people aboard and 19 deaths on the ground.
sources: Ministry of Civil Aviation parliamentary answer

title: Shooting of Minnesota state legislators
location: Brooklyn Park and Champlin, Minnesota, United States
description: On June 14, 2025, Vance Boelter killed Minnesota Representative Melissa Hortman and her husband Mark at their Brooklyn Park home and wounded Senator John Hoffman and his wife Yvette in Champlin. After his arrest, he pleaded guilty to federal murder and related charges on June 11, 2026; the separate state prosecution remained pending as of September 21, 2026.

title: 2026 Venezuela earthquakes
description: Two earthquakes, reported at magnitudes 7.2 and 7.5, struck north-central Venezuela on 24 June 2026, causing widespread destruction, particularly in La Guaira. Official figures cited by UNICEF recorded 6,125 deaths as of 3 August. Homes and infrastructure were damaged and many residents displaced.

title: Angara Airlines Flight 2311 crash
description: On July 24, 2025, an Angara Airlines Antonov An-24 operating Flight 2311 crashed near Tynda in Russia's Amur region while approaching its destination. All 42 passengers and six crew members died.

title: Gansu flash flood at Weiyuan scenic area
description: A flash flood struck a scenic area in Weiyuan County, Dingxi City, on the afternoon of 26 July 2026, killing 25 people and injuring 23. China's national disaster commission said it would oversee an investigation into the disaster and urged Gansu Province to strengthen disaster prevention, mitigation and relief capacity.

title: Kumamoto earthquake
description: An earthquake measured at magnitude 7.1 by Japan's Meteorological Agency struck Kumamoto at 16:27 local time on 28 July 2026. Prefectural figures as of 3 August recorded 38 deaths, 98 injuries and 8,383 evacuees. Damage included an explosion and collapse at Aeon Mall in Kashima and a chimney collapse at a paper mill in Yatsushiro.

title: Firefighting helicopter crash in San Juan kills seven
description: A Bell 412 helicopter contracted by Argentina's Federal Emergency Agency crashed near Ischigualasto Provincial Park in San Juan on 29 July 2026, killing all seven occupants. It had previously taken part in training and was travelling toward La Rioja to assist firefighting operations. Contact was lost at about 10:26 local time.

title: Wildfires in southern Greece kill three firefighters
location: Rethymno, Crete and Gytheio, Laconia, Greece
description: Three firefighters died during wildfire response operations in southern Greece on 29 July 2026. Two died in a fire in the Rethymno region of Crete. A third was found unconscious near a fire in the Gytheio area and pronounced dead in hospital; authorities had not established the cause of his death.

title: Broad Peak avalanche kills ten climbers
description: An avalanche struck ten climbers on Broad Peak in Pakistan's Karakoram range on the morning of 30 July 2026. All ten, including Nirmal Purja, were subsequently confirmed dead. Recovery operations continued after the first bodies were located, with weather and terrain hindering access.

title: Flash floods and landslides in Dien Bien Province
description: Flash floods and landslides struck Dien Bien Province early on 1 August 2025 local time (31 July UTC), after heavy rain. A subsequent provincial tally reported ten deaths and seven injuries. Homes and roads were damaged and several communities isolated.

title: Terrorist attack on labourers in Kulgam
description: Gunmen shot two workers from Chhattisgarh at a brick kiln in Kelam, Kulgam district, on the evening of 31 July 2026. One died initially and the second later died in hospital, bringing the death toll to two.

title: Bombing at Moscow restaurant kills five
description: A bomb exploded near the Balzi Rossi restaurant on Kudrinskaya Square in Moscow on the evening of 1 August 2026. Authorities initially reported three deaths, including the woman carrying the device, a security guard and a visitor. A subsequent Russian embassy statement reported five dead and 19 injured.

title: Israeli strikes kill at least seven in Gaza
description: Gaza's civil defence reported seven people killed in Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip since dawn on 1 August 2026. An Israeli strike also destroyed medical supplies stored for Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital in Deir al-Balah, according to hospital and Palestinian health officials.

title: Taliban police report killing seven alleged robbers in Kabul
description: Taliban police said seven men accused of armed robbery were killed during an operation in Kabul's Police District 8 on 1 August 2026. Police described a confrontation at about 21:00 local time. A former Afghan justice minister subsequently described the killings as extrajudicial; the police account was not independently established.

title: Drone strike on Darfur community court kills at least 46, rights group reports
description: A drone strike hit Zawiya Ghara community court in North Darfur during a court session on 2 August 2026. Emergency Lawyers initially reported at least 35 deaths. Darfur Victims Support Organization later reported 46 civilian deaths and seven injuries in preliminary documentation based on interviews with families and witnesses. Rights groups attributed the strike to the Sudanese army.

title: Firefighting helicopters collide in Greece killing two
description: Two firefighting helicopters collided in mid-air on Sunday while battling a wind-driven wildfire west of Athens, and one caught fire and crashed. A Greek and a Danish crew member died; the two survivors — a Greek and a British national — were taken to hospital in Athens.

title: Israeli strikes kill 18 in Gaza
description: Israeli airstrikes across Gaza on 2 August 2026 killed at least 18 Palestinians, including children, according to medics. Strikes hit Gaza City, Deir al-Balah and Khan Younis. The toll may overlap the 18 newly killed people in the health ministry's next-day 24-hour bulletin and must not be counted again.

title: Russian glide bombs kill one in Zaporizhzhia
description: Russian aircraft dropped eight glide bombs on residential districts of Zaporizhzhia within 90 minutes on Sunday evening, killing a 71-year-old woman, wounding 31 people — including a 16-year-old girl — and damaging 22 apartment buildings in four districts of the city.

title: Drone crash on Gelendzhik-area beach kills eight
description: A drone crashed onto a beach at Arkhipo-Osipovka near Gelendzhik on the morning of 3 August 2026. Later reporting put the toll at eight deaths, including four children, with 58 injured. Russia attributed the drone to Ukraine; whether air defences caused it to crash remained uncertain.

title: Israeli strike kills two in Gaza City
description: An Israeli airstrike targeted a vehicle southwest of Gaza City on Monday evening, killing two Palestinians in the Sheikh Ajlin area, in another violation of the ceasefire that took effect in October 2025, medical sources said.

title: Russian guided bombs kill three in Sumy
description: Russian guided aerial bombs struck Sumy between 02:08 and 02:17 local time on 4 August 2026 (3 August UTC). The attack killed two girls aged five and ten and a 75-year-old woman, according to Ukrainian reports, and injured other residents. Homes and civilian infrastructure were damaged.

title: Lightning strike kills footballer in Thailand
description: A lightning strike during a Golok FA Cup match at Santiphap Stadium in Sungai Golok, Narathiwat, on the afternoon of 4 August 2026 killed 24-year-old Yala FC player Sofwan Awae. At least nine others were reported injured.

title: Explosion in southern Lebanon kills two Israeli soldiers
description: Two Israeli reservists from Battalion 2855 of the 55th Reserve Paratroopers Brigade were killed and four seriously wounded in an explosion during an operation in Majdal Zoun on 5 August 2026, the Israeli military announced the following day. The circumstances of the explosive device were under investigation.

title: Israeli airstrike on south Lebanon kills one
description: An Israeli drone strike hit the roof of a prayer hall at a cemetery in Tebnine, Bint Jbeil district, on 5 August 2026. Lebanon's Health Ministry reported one person killed and twelve injured, updating an initial report of eleven injuries. The strike came as a round of Lebanese-Israeli talks in Rome concluded.

title: Mass shooting in Caswell County, North Carolina kills three
location: Caswell County, North Carolina, United States
description: A mass shooting at a rural home in Caswell County, North Carolina, left three family members dead - including the suspected shooter - and a fourth relative hospitalized, according to the Caswell County Sheriff's Office and the North Carolina State Bureau of Investigation.

title: Rain-triggered house collapse kills six in Pratapgarh, India
description: A house collapsed during heavy rain in Mahuli, Pratapgarh district, at about 2 a.m. local time on August 6, killing six members of a family, including two young children.

title: ATF operation in Nashville ends with man and teenager fatally shot
description: James Salinas, 32, and Denzel Molina, 16, were fatally shot during an ATF firearms operation on Landers Avenue in Nashville on August 6. The Tennessee Bureau of Investigation said agents encountered two people and gunfire was exchanged; it was investigating the circumstances. No officers were injured.

title: Russian drone strike on Lozova train station kills two
description: Russian drones struck railway infrastructure and the station in Lozova on August 6, killing two railway workers aged 52 and 59 and injuring 11 people, according to regional police.

title: Wildfire kills bulldozer operator in Oregon
description: Jason Ensign, a 47-year-old equipment operator, died while operating a bulldozer at the Wrights Spring Fire in Oregon on August 6. Rapid fire growth cut off his escape route while he helped construct fire lines.

title: Firefighting helicopter crash near Utah wildfire kills two
description: Two pilots died when a contracted CH-54A firefighting helicopter crashed near Kanosh at about 10:41 a.m. local time on August 7 while dropping water on the Widemouth 2 Fire.

title: Thailand school shooting kills nine
description: A student killed his grandparents before attacking Debsirin Nonthaburi School on the morning of August 7, killing five staff members and injuring more than 20 people. The shooter also died. A wounded pupil died on August 8, bringing the reported total, including the shooter and the grandparents, to nine.

title: Helicopter crash in Rio de Janeiro kills four
location: Alto da Boa Vista, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
description: A Robinson 44 helicopter crashed in a forested area near Vista Chinesa in the Tijuca National Park in Rio de Janeiro on Saturday morning, killing all four people on board, firefighters said.

title: Landslide on rain-soaked hillside in Baguio kills 10
description: A landslide struck houses in Guisad Surong, Baguio, on the evening of August 9 during prolonged monsoon rain. By early August 11, rescuers had accounted for all 13 reported victims: ten died and three survived.

title: Russian missile strike on Kharkiv apartment block kills two
description: Russian missiles struck a high-rise apartment block in Kharkiv's Saltivskyi district on Sunday morning, August 9, killing two people, two men aged 50 and 66, and injuring more than a dozen others, according to regional head Oleh Syniehubov.

title: Sofa factory fire in Riyadh kills 16 Bangladeshi workers
description: A fire broke out on Sunday at a sofa manufacturing factory in the Musa Sanaiya industrial area of Riyadh, killing at least 16 Bangladeshi migrant workers, according to Bangladesh's Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment Ministry. Ten of the victims were from the Naogaon district and others from Natore and Rajshahi.

title: Two tribal elders shot dead in South Waziristan, Pakistan
location: Toi Khulla, Lower South Waziristan, Pakistan
description: Unidentified gunmen killed tribal elders Haji Gul and Malik Badshah while they traveled toward Zarmilan in Lower South Waziristan on August 9. Police said the attack occurred near Darozanda in Toi Khulla tehsil; both men belonged to the Suleman Khel tribe.

title: Magnitude 7.4 earthquake in western Colombia kills at least 331
location: Western Colombia (Choco; Cali, Pereira, Manizales, Quibdo)
description: A magnitude 7.4 earthquake struck western Colombia at 12:34 UTC on August 10, with its epicenter near San Jose del Palmar, Choco. UNGRD's September 3 assessment reported 331 deaths and 466,606 people affected. Buildings collapsed and landslides damaged communities in the affected region.

title: Murder-suicide at Chicago elementary school leaves two custodians dead
description: A shooting at Mark Twain Elementary School in Chicago's Garfield Ridge neighborhood on August 10 killed custodian Amalia Bautista Perez, 48, and her 63-year-old coworker. The medical examiner classified their deaths as homicide and suicide respectively. No children were in the school.

title: Palestinian girl dies of wounds from Israeli fire in Gaza
location: Al-Mawasi, Khan Younis, Gaza Strip, Palestine
description: Thirteen-year-old Saba Naim Abdullah al-Hashash died on August 10 from wounds sustained when Israeli forces shot her several days earlier in the Al-Mawasi area of Khan Younis, according to WAFA.

title: Russian artillery strike on Buhaivka village in Kharkiv region kills five
location: Buhaivka, Chuhuiv district, Kharkiv Oblast, Ukraine
description: Russian forces carried out a massive artillery strike on the residential area of the village of Buhaivka in the Chuhuiv district of Kharkiv Oblast on August 10, killing five people and destroying several houses, according to regional authorities and the prosecutor's office.

title: Russian strike on Zaporizhstal kills eight workers
description: A Russian ballistic-missile attack struck the Zaporizhstal steel plant around 00:30 local time on August 11, or August 10 UTC. The plant later reported eight employees killed and 26 injured in that attack, which halted production.

title: Ferry capsizes on Lake Kariba killing 46
description: An overloaded ferry capsized on Lake Kariba on August 11 after encountering strong waves. Police reported 46 deaths by August 13, while the disaster-management agency said 77 people had been rescued. Authorities had not established a definitive passenger or missing-person count.

title: Ferry fire off Bali kills one
description: The Putri Yasmin ferry caught fire between Bali and Lombok around 4:15 a.m. local time on August 12, or August 11 UTC. Rescuers evacuated 211 people and recovered a 19-year-old Indonesian woman's body, authorities reported.

title: Landslide on Mumbai chawl kills eight
description: A rain-triggered landslide struck homes at Gaushiya Chawl in Chirag Nagar, Mumbai, around 3:48 a.m. local time on August 12, or August 11 UTC. The death toll rose to eight before search operations ended on August 13; seven others were injured.

title: Russian strike on tanker truck in Odesa region kills two
description: A Russian strike hit a tanker truck containing oil residue in Odesa region on August 11. Regional administration head Oleh Kiper reported two people killed and three wounded.

title: Military Apache helicopter crash near Salado kills two
description: An AH-64 Apache attack helicopter from Fort Hood crashed into a field south of Salado, Texas, around 1:35 p.m. local time, killing both pilots on board and igniting a grass fire that forced nearby residents to flee.

title: Armed man fatally shot by police at Auckland shopping centre
description: An armed man fleeing from police was shot and killed at Sylvia Park Shopping Centre in Auckland on Thursday afternoon. Police said the man had stolen an air rifle from a gun shop in Penrose; he was confronted under an overpass and pronounced dead at the scene despite first aid.

title: Bomb blast kills defected naval officer in Sevastopol
description: An explosion in Sevastopol on the morning of August 13 killed a Russian naval officer later identified in reporting as Robert Shageyev, a former Ukrainian submarine commander who defected in 2014. Russian authorities said they detained a woman and alleged Ukrainian intelligence involvement; that allegation was not independently verified.

title: Explosion at Fujian shipyard kills firefighter
description: A fire at Huahai Shipyard in Gantang, Fu'an, began at 13:09 local time on August 13. An explosion at 14:10 injured ten firefighters and two other people; one firefighter died in hospital that evening. Authorities were investigating the cause.

title: Explosion at Port of Rotterdam kills one
description: An explosion at the Port of Rotterdam in the Netherlands killed at least one person and injured several others on August 13, 2026. Dutch regional broadcaster Rijnmond reported the blast occurred at around 11:30 a.m. local time; Rotterdam police said the cause remained under investigation and emergency services scaled up their response.

title: Firecracker factory explosion near Sivakasi kills two workers
description: Two men died after an explosion while testing a new chemical-mixing machine at a fireworks factory near Sivakasi on August 13. One died at the site and the second in hospital. Police opened an investigation into the cause.

title: Israeli strikes kill two Palestinians in Gaza
description: Israeli strikes killed Gaza police official Jamal Abu Kamil in Gaza City and Hudhaifa Kawara in Khan Younis on August 13, according to Palestinian medical and interior-ministry sources. Israel said Abu Kamil was a Hamas commander.

title: Landslide and water seepage in Chamoli tunnel kills seven workers
description: A sudden influx of water and debris entered the Vishnugad-Pipalkoti project's unfinished tunnel in Chamoli around 6:20 p.m. local time on August 13. At least seven workers died and others were injured, with searches continuing for missing workers.

title: Mudslide in Changxing, Zhejiang kills one and leaves three missing
description: A rain-triggered mudslide collapsed a house in Tanlongqiao village, Heping town, Changxing, around 6:30 a.m. local time on August 14, or August 13 UTC. County authorities reported one confirmed death and three people missing that afternoon.

title: Multi-vehicle crash near Accra kills at least 11
description: A multi-vehicle collision on the Accra-Kumasi highway at Ofankor Barrier in Ghana's capital killed at least 11 people and injured 13 others in the early hours of August 13, 2026, according to the Ghana National Fire Service. The service said it received a distress call at about 4:00 a.m. local time regarding the collision.

title: Record rainfall in Chiba kills thirteen
description: Record rainfall on August 13-14 flooded communities in Chiba Prefecture. The governor reported thirteen deaths, one person missing and damage to more than 4,500 homes by August 27.

title: Russian drone strike on passenger train in Odesa region kills two
description: A Russian drone struck a passenger train in Berezivka district, Odesa region, on August 13, killing the driver and his assistant. Authorities evacuated the 340 passengers, including 67 children; no passengers were reported injured.

title: Suspected murder-suicide shooting on Staten Island kills two
location: Staten Island, New York, United States
description: Police responded to a shooting at a Garth Court home on Staten Island around 11:10 a.m. on August 13. Dana Foley, 39, died at the scene, while Dakota Suckstorff, 27, died after being taken to hospital. Police investigated a suspected murder-suicide.

title: Coal mine explosion in Cucunuba kills six miners
description: Six miners died in a methane-associated explosion at the Porvenir 1 coal mine in Cucunuba on August 14. Colombia's National Mining Agency confirmed the deaths and ordered operations suspended pending compliance with safety requirements.

title: Helicopter crash in Sehmatal, Saxony kills pilot
description: A helicopter crashed and caught fire during forestry work near Neudorf in Sehmatal on the morning of August 14. Workers pulled the 29-year-old pilot from the aircraft, but he died at the scene. Police received the report at 9:55 a.m. and opened an investigation with the aviation accident authority.

title: Magnitude 7.7 earthquake near Flores kills at least 68
description: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck near Flores at 21:58 UTC on August 14, or 5:58 a.m. local time on August 15. BNPB reported 68 identified deaths by August 17. The earthquake damaged buildings, triggered landslides and small tsunami waves, and displaced residents.

title: RSF attack on Um Arada reportedly kills at least eighteen
description: An RSF attack on Um Arada southwest of El Obeid on August 14 killed at least eighteen people and wounded seventeen, according to local-source reporting carried by Europa Press. Rights and local reports documented more than fourteen civilian deaths and displacement toward El Obeid.

title: Russian double drone strike on Sumy region kills woman and nine-year-old boy
description: Russian forces launched a double strike with jet-powered UAVs on a private home in the Buryn community of Ukraine's Sumy region early on August 14, 2026, killing a 29-year-old woman and her nine-year-old son and wounding four others, including the boy's father and grandmother who were hospitalized with severe burns. The attack caused extensive damage and sparked a fire, according to the Sumy Regional Military Administration.

title: Series of shootings in Michigan kills six including gunman
description: Five people were killed in shootings in Missaukee County on August 14, and suspect Chad Hickman, 39, was later found dead. Police found victims at two homes and in woods near Whitlock Lake; another person was critically injured. The six-death total includes the suspect.

title: Toxic gas at Sitakunda shipbreaking yard kills ten workers
description: Workers at Ferdous Steel's Sitakunda shipbreaking yard were exposed to toxic gas inside a vessel on August 14. Authorities identified hydrogen sulfide. The reported death toll rose to ten after another worker died in hospital on August 19.

title: Flash flood and landslide in Ponferrada area kill two women
description: A flash flood and debris flow struck Manzanedo de Valdueza and nearby settlements in the Ponferrada area on August 15, killing two women. Four other people, including two children, were injured. An elderly man initially missing was found unharmed.

title: Israeli forces kill 14-year-old Palestinian in Khan Younis
description: Fourteen-year-old Suhail Masoud Shalouf was shot by Israeli forces on al-Tina Street south of Khan Younis on the evening of August 15, according to WAFA. The Palestinian Red Crescent recovered his body the following day.

title: Polish tourist bus overturns on Hungarian motorway killing 12
description: A bus carrying 57 Polish passengers and two drivers overturned on Hungary's M3 motorway near Mezokeresztes at about 01:00 local time on August 16, killing 12 people. Emergency services later reported 47 injured, including 10 seriously. Police detained the driver.

title: Shooting at Lexington, Kentucky park kills one and injures four
description: A shooting during the East End Day gathering at Charles Young Park in Lexington on August 15 killed sixteen-year-old Di'Zhon Robertson and wounded four people, including children. Police responded shortly before 7 p.m. local time.

title: Landslide hits apartment in Geoje, South Korea, killing one
location: Okpo-dong, Geoje, South Gyeongsang, South Korea
description: A rain-triggered landslide struck a ground-floor apartment in Okpo-dong, Geoje, early on August 17 local time. Three people were rescued; one subsequently died. The other two survived.

title: Wildfires on Salamina kill two
description: An elderly couple died during wildfires on Salamina on August 16. Fires broke out around midday in Peristeria and Selinia, prompting evacuations, including hundreds of people taken off the island by sea.

title: Pickup-truck collision on Gwalior-Bhind highway kills eight labourers
description: A pickup carrying migrant labourers collided with a dumper truck near Chhimka in Bhind district around 01:00 local time on August 18. Eight people were killed and numerous others injured.

title: Russian drone strike on Dniprovska mine near Pavlohrad kills one worker
location: Bohdanivske, Pavlohrad district, Dnipropetrovsk region, Ukraine
description: Russian drones struck the Dniprovska mine in the Bohdanivske community of Dnipropetrovsk region on August 17, killing one employee and injuring another, according to DTEK and local reporting.

title: School shooting in Zamboanga City leaves two dead, including attacker
description: A student shot another student and then himself at Ateneo de Zamboanga University's junior high school campus in Zamboanga City on the morning of August 18 local time. Police and the university confirmed two deaths, including the attacker.

title: Israeli airstrike on cafe near Gaza Port kills six
description: An Israeli strike hit a crowded seaside cafe near Gaza City's fishing port on August 18, killing six Palestinians, including a child, according to medical and eyewitness reports.

title: Russian missile strike on Pechenihy in Kharkiv region kills ten
description: A Russian missile strike hit the centre of Pechenihy in Kharkiv region on the morning of August 18, killing ten people, Ukrainian officials said. Shops, a post office and residential buildings were damaged, and numerous people were injured.

title: Fire in commercial building in Qinhuangdao kills eight
description: A fire broke out in a ground-floor commercial property in Haigang district, Qinhuangdao, at about 03:40 local time on August 20. Eight people were killed and three injured. The fire was extinguished and its cause was under investigation.

title: Charter plane crash in western Alaska kills all eight on board
description: A charter aircraft crashed near a remote radar facility in western Alaska on August 20, 2026, killing all eight people on board. The US Air Force confirmed there were no survivors, and rescue teams faced difficult access to the crash site.

title: Gang attack on Kenscoff in Haiti kills at least 47
description: Armed gangs attacked Kenscoff late on August 23 local time, killing residents, burning homes and attacking a church sheltering displaced people. AP reported at least 47 deaths by August 30. The final incident-specific toll remained uncertain.

title: Montana man kills eight relatives and himself at family dinner
description: A man killed eight relatives, including four children, at a family home outside Billings on Sunday evening, August 23 local time, before dying by suicide. Police responded shortly after 18:00, and the house caught fire. Nine people died, including the attacker.

title: Ice-rock avalanche triggers Nepal-Tibet flood killing at least 1,446
location: Bhote Koshi valley, Rasuwagadhi, Nepal / Tibet border
description: An ice-rock avalanche near the Nepal-Tibet border triggered a destructive flood through the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli river corridors on August 26. Reporting by September 17 put recovered deaths at 1,403 in Nepal and 43 in China, a combined 1,446. Another 6,669 people were reported missing across both countries, separately from the death toll. Scientific analysis indicated warming likely contributed to slope instability.

title: Church minibus collision in central Zimbabwe kills 27
description: A minibus carrying church members collided head-on with a truck that was overtaking in central Zimbabwe on August 28, 2026, killing at least 27 people. Police reported the crash on Saturday, August 29, in the latest deadly road accident to hit the country.

title: Israeli strikes kill five in Gaza and three in West Bank
location: Gaza Strip and West Bank, Palestine
description: Israeli airstrikes on August 28, 2026 killed five people in Gaza and three in the West Bank city of Jenin, according to Palestinian health officials. The strikes came amid continuing Israeli military operations despite the ceasefire framework, as tensions persisted across the occupied territories.

title: Russian drone strike on ammunition warehouse near Kyiv kills 38
location: Myla, Bucha district, Kyiv region, Ukraine
description: A Russian drone strike hit an ammunition storage site in Myla on the evening of August 28, triggering explosions and fires in nearby buildings. President Zelenskyy reported 38 deaths and 20 injuries on August 30, with four people still missing. Authorities opened an inquiry into the storage arrangements.

title: Israeli strikes kill at least five across the Gaza Strip
description: Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip on August 31, 2026, killed at least five people, according to Palestinian health officials. The strikes hit several parts of the enclave amid the continuing Israel-Hamas war.

title: US airstrike on wedding party in Hormozgan province kills five
description: A US strike hit a home hosting a wedding celebration in Kuhestak on the evening of September 1, according to Iranian authorities and AP's subsequent on-scene reporting. Five people died, including a woman who died in hospital September 3, and more than 60 were injured. Vice President JD Vance said September 3 that the US was investigating.

title: Bus crash in South Sinai, Egypt, kills at least 22
description: A bus crashed in South Sinai, Egypt, on September 2, 2026, killing at least 22 people, including ten Jordanian nationals, and injuring 28 others. The bus was travelling between the Red Sea towns of Dahab and Nuweiba when the accident occurred.

title: Minivan collision on Sege highway in Ghana kills 13
description: A collision involving two passenger minivans on the Sege section of the Accra-Aflao highway killed 13 people on September 2. Others were injured, according to Ghanaian news reports quoting emergency personnel.

title: Minneapolis apartment shooting leaves three dead, including attacker
description: A gunman killed two people at an apartment building in Minneapolis's Loring Park neighborhood on September 2 before police shot and killed him. Three civilians and three officers were injured; two of the officers suffered gunshot wounds.

title: Explosion at military base in Viacha, Bolivia, kills nine
description: Explosions struck the Bolivar military regiment in Viacha on the afternoon of September 4. Authorities confirmed nine deaths by September 8, with five people still missing, and later reported 84 injured. The cause remained under investigation.

title: Fire at wedding party in Kinshasa kills at least 12
location: Lingwala, Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
description: A fire broke out during a wedding reception at the Panacee hall in Lingwala, Kinshasa, on the evening of September 4. The government's subsequent official account reported 12 deaths, lower than initial local estimates of 22. Investigators were still determining the cause.

title: Mudslide in Mingkeng village, Jiangxi, kills 13
location: Mingkeng village, Suichuan County, Jiangxi, China
description: A mudslide struck Mingkeng village in Gaoping, Suichuan County, around 04:00 local time on September 5 after prolonged rain associated with Typhoon Saudel. Thirteen people died in this mudslide. The separate countywide total of 16 included deaths in two other towns.

title: Bus crash on Fogo island, Cape Verde, kills at least 25
description: A passenger bus left a mountain road between Cha das Caldeiras and Campanas de Cima on Fogo island late on September 5, killing 25 people and injuring 14. Many victims were children and adolescents.

title: Fuel tanker explosion on Hamedan-Sanandaj highway, Iran, kills 11
description: A fuel tanker suffered an apparent brake failure, hit other vehicles and exploded on the Hamedan-Sanandaj highway in western Iran on September 5, 2026, killing 11 people and injuring seven others. The initial reported toll of 10 was later revised upward.

title: Avalanche on Mount Mizhirgi, Russia, kills 17 climbers
description: An avalanche hit a group of 33 climbers on Mount Mizhirgi in the Bezengi Gorge on September 6. Search teams recovered the final missing person on September 13, bringing the death toll to 17. Sixteen survived, including six who were hospitalized.

title: Cargo plane crash at Miami airport kills five
description: A Boeing 767-300 cargo plane operated by 21 Air for Amazon Air overshot the runway and struck vehicles while landing at Miami International Airport on September 6, 2026, killing five people and injuring five others.

title: Fireworks explosion at religious celebration in Temascalcingo, Mexico, kills 10
description: Fireworks exploded beside the Nuestra Senora de la Luz church in Santa Maria Canchesda, Temascalcingo, during a religious celebration on the night of September 5 local time. Ten people were killed and 64 injured. The cause was under investigation.

title: Hostel building collapse in New Delhi kills seven
description: A five-storey building housing a private hostel collapsed in Satya Niketan on the afternoon of September 6. The death toll reached seven by September 7, and twelve people were rescued and taken to hospital.

title: Helicopter crash in Sarawak, Malaysia, kills five
description: A MBB Bo 105 helicopter operated for the Flying Doctors of Malaysia crashed near Long Lellang in Sarawak, Malaysian Borneo, on September 8, 2026, killing all five people on board.

title: Landslide at forest-road work site in Shizuoka kills one worker
description: A landslide at a forest-road construction site in Kawanehoncho trapped a male worker on the morning of September 8. He was transported from the site the next day and confirmed dead.

title: Explosion at Ritom hydroelectric plant in Switzerland kills two workers
description: Two workers died after a fire and explosion at the old Ritom hydroelectric plant in Piotta, Ticino, shortly after 09:30 local time on September 9. Cantonal police described a serious workplace accident.

title: Explosion at weapons depot in Sarmada, Syria, kills 14
description: An explosion at a temporary depot for weapons and war remnants near Sarmada, Idlib, on September 9 killed 14 people and injured 11, according to the local health department's updated account.

title: Israeli strike kills family of four in northern Gaza
description: An Israeli airstrike hit the Ahmed family's home near Kamal Adwan Hospital in northern Gaza at about 01:45 local time on 10 September 2026, or late 9 September UTC. Two parents and their two daughters were killed, according to Palestinian medical and human-rights reporting.

title: Russian drone strike on shopping centre in Sumy kills two
description: A Russian drone hit the parking area of the Manufactura shopping centre in Sumy on the evening of 9 September 2026, killing two people. An initial report of three deaths was corrected. Subsequent reporting put the number injured at 23.

title: Cargo ship fire at Qingdao port kills 25
description: A fire broke out aboard a foreign-flagged cargo ship at a port in Qingdao, Shandong province, eastern China, on September 10, 2026. The death toll rose to 25 during the day as rescue and recovery operations continued aboard the vessel; authorities did not immediately announce a cause.

title: Church roof collapse in Vellore, India, kills three
location: Manju Krishnapuram, Thiruvalam, Vellore district, Tamil Nadu, India
description: The roof of the under-construction CSI Zion Hill Church at Manjukrishnapuram near Thiruvalam in Vellore district collapsed during concreting at about 16:30 local time on 10 September 2026. Three workers were killed and 14 others were injured.

title: Grenade attack on house in Dehiwala, Sri Lanka, kills two children
description: A grenade attack on a house in Dehiwala killed two brothers aged 11 and 17 and injured their father at about 03:20 local time on 11 September 2026, or late 10 September UTC. Police said the attackers appeared to have targeted the wrong house in suspected gang retaliation.

title: Tour bus crash in eastern Switzerland kills five
description: A Dutch tour bus crashed between Zernez and Susch in the Swiss canton of Graubunden at about 16:45 local time on 10 September 2026. Police reported five deaths and 40 injuries among the 44 adult passengers and driver.

title: Drone attacks on cars in Kramatorsk
description: Three people were killed in separate drone attacks on cars in Kramatorsk, according to local authorities. The city council reported three incidents within about 90 minutes.

title: N1 minibus collision in Western Cape
location: Between Leeu Gamka and Prince Albert, Western Cape, South Africa
description: A collision involving two minibuses and an SUV killed at least 21 people, according to Western Cape officials. Three of the reported victims died after being taken to hospital.

title: Drone strike on passenger bus in Nikopol district
description: A drone strike on a passenger bus killed five people, according to regional authorities, who attributed the attack to Russian forces.

title: Fatal flooding near Newcomb on the Navajo Nation
location: Newcomb and Two Grey Hills area, New Mexico, United States
description: Two adults and a child died in flooding on the Navajo Nation. Police said their bodies were found near the Newcomb and Two Grey Hills area following overnight flooding.

title: News helicopter crash in Chatsworth
location: Chatsworth, Los Angeles, California, United States
description: A television news helicopter crashed while covering a nearby traffic collision. Two people aboard the aircraft and one person on the ground were killed.

title: SUV and Metro bus collision in Chatsworth
location: Chatsworth, Los Angeles, California, United States
description: Two people died and six others were injured when an SUV collided with a Metro bus, according to the Los Angeles Fire Department.

title: Fatal debris from drone interception near Taif
description: Saudi civil defence said debris from an intercepted drone killed a Yemeni resident and injured two other people. Saudi authorities attributed the drone launch to Yemen's Houthis.

title: Bombing and gun attack on police headquarters in Kohat
description: A bombing and gun attack on a police compound killed at least 31 people, according to the victim toll reported by authorities on September 19. The attack began the previous afternoon.

title: Fatal strike in Jabalia
description: A strike in Jabalia killed one person, according to Palestinian medical sources. This entry records only the Jabalia death, not the larger daily Gaza toll.

title: Fatal strike in Shuja'iyya
description: A strike in Shuja'iyya killed one person, according to Palestinian medical sources. This entry excludes other deaths reported elsewhere in Gaza that day.

title: Fatal shooting near Neve Tzuf
location: Near Neve Tzuf, occupied West Bank
description: A Palestinian gunman shot dead an Israeli man near Neve Tzuf, according to Israeli authorities. The suspect was subsequently detained.

title: Palestinian motorist killed near Ganim
location: Near Ganim, Jenin area, occupied West Bank
description: Israeli troops shot dead a Palestinian motorist. The Israeli military alleged an attempted vehicle attack; Reuters said it could not independently verify the circumstances.

title: Reported airstrike on displacement camp in Kunar
description: Afghan provincial officials said an airstrike killed three people at a camp for families displaced by an earthquake. They attributed the strike to Pakistan; Pakistan's military had not commented in the cited initial report.
